design_philosophy: Awwwards-level liquid glass morphism aesthetic with a strict grayscale palette and no colored accents. Built over a looping fullscreen video background with multiple layers of blurred glass mimicking liquid properties.

fonts.usage: Primary font for display, headings, and body. Use font-weight 500 for headings.
Accent font strictly for italicized words inside headings and specific quote sections.

colors.palette: Strictly grayscale. All HSL values must be 0 0% X%.
colors.forbidden: No colored accents under any circumstances. No gradients containing hue.

global.borders: NO border classes anywhere. Borders are strictly handled by glass ::before pseudo-elements.

custom_css_classes.name: .liquid-glass
custom_css_classes.properties: backdrop-filter: blur(4px); background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.01); mix-blend-mode: luminosity; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.05); position: relative;
custom_css_classes.pseudo_before: content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 1px; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(255,255,255,0.2), rgba(255,255,255,0.02)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none;

custom_css_classes.name: .liquid-glass-strong
custom_css_classes.properties: backdrop-filter: blur(50px); background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); mix-blend-mode: normal; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2), inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); position: relative;
custom_css_classes.pseudo_before: content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 1px; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.05)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none;

hero_section.container: relative min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row overflow-hidden z-10
hero_section.video_background: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover z-0

left_panel.structure: relative flex flex-col h-full inset-4 lg:inset-6 rounded-3xl p-6 lg:p-12 justify-between

right_panel.structure: relative flex flex-col h-full p-6 lg:p-12 pl-0 justify-between

left_panel_elements.navigation: Flex row, items center, justify between. Left: App Logo + 'resqnet' wordmark. Right: Menu pill button (.liquid-glass).
left_panel_elements.hero_content: Centered vertically. Contains an 80px Logo icon, H1 heading (text-6xl/7xl tracking-[-0.05em]) utilizing Source Serif 4 italic accent lines. Below heading, a `.liquid-glass-strong` CTA pill with an icon wrapped in a white/15 circle.
left_panel_elements.feature_pills: Flex row/wrap containing three small `.liquid-glass` feature pills.
left_panel_elements.quote_block: Bottom aligned. Includes 'VISIONARY' label (uppercase, tracked out), mixed serif/sans quote text, and author attribution with horizontal accent lines (border-t/border-b using white/20).

right_panel_elements.top_bar: Flex row, justify end, gap 4. Contains social icons pill (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram + ArrowRight) and an account Sparkles button.
right_panel_elements.bottom_feature: Outer container `.liquid-glass` rounded-[2.5rem] holding two side-by-side cards (Wand2, BookOpen icons) and one full-width bottom card. Bottom card includes a 96x64 image thumbnail (left aligned), title/description text, and a '+' icon button on the right.

below_fold_elements.marquee: Slow editorial marquee strip using react-fast-marquee. Content: 'MULTI-AGENCY COORDINATION / RAPID RESPONSE TACTICS / UNIFIED COMMAND CENTER / REAL-TIME DATA SYNC'. Text styling: tracking wide, uppercase, white/50, no color.
below_fold_elements.manifesto_chapters: Numbered sections (01, 02, 03) detailing multi-agency coordination. Large display numbers, mixed serif/sans layout, strict grayscale `.liquid-glass` aesthetic. Staggered reveals on scroll.

motion.entrance_animations: Use framer-motion. Implement masked line-by-line reveals for hero headings. Staggered glass element fade-ins (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for pills and cards.
motion.interactions: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, pills, cards) must have `hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.
motion.scroll: Implement `@studio-freight/lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. Map scroll events to framer-motion `useScroll` for below-the-fold reveals.

video.usage: Fullscreen hero background, looping, muted, playsInline, object-cover, z-index 0.

images.description: Grayscale photography of army/rescue coordination (96x64 px thumbnail inside bottom right feature card).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast of text over the video background using the liquid-glass layers.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`, `data-testid="menu-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
Add Poppins and Source Serif 4 to index.css or via Google Fonts in index.html.
Append .liquid-glass and .liquid-glass-strong exactly as defined in the visual_enhancers to the index.css @layer components.
Do NOT use any Tailwind border classes (e.g., border, border-white). All borders are handled by the custom CSS ::before mask.
Ensure layout is exactly split 52% left, 48% right on large screens, with the left panel acting as a floating glass card.
Strictly follow the grayscale palette. NO colors. If you need shades, use white with opacity (white/80, white/60, etc).
Replace 'Bloom' copy with 'RESQNET' and disaster coordination language.
Ensure the hero header (text-6xl/7xl) has negative tracking and incorporates an italicized Source Serif 4 span.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll wrapping the entire app.
Create the slow Marquee below the fold followed by the manifesto 01/02/03.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never center align the app container in App.css (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties like transform and opacity.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
